system.description:
Gully Dwarf

Gully dwarves are the most debased and pitiable of the dwarven subraces. Possibly a crossbreed between dwarves and gnomes from ages past, gully dwarves are short even by dwarven standards, filthy, and largely shunned by other demi-humans. They survive as scavengers in the ruins and refuse-heaps of other civilizations, particularly around the encampments of ogres and orcs. Despite their wretched circumstances and limited intellect, gully dwarves possess a remarkable talent for survival and an absurd amount of luck. They are chaotic neutral as a rule, caring little for order or morality — only for the next meal.

Ability Score Adjustments

  • Intelligence: −2
  • Charisma: −2

Racial Traits

  • Infravision: 60 feet.
  • Lucky: Once per encounter, a gully dwarf may reroll any single saving throw or attack roll and keep the better result. This reflects their absurd capacity for survival against all odds.
  • Scavenge: Gully dwarves can find food and useful refuse in almost any environment. They have a base 80% chance to find enough food to survive in urban, subterranean, or wilderness settings.
  • Constitution-based Saving Throw Bonus: +1 per 3.5 Constitution vs. poison and disease (they have been exposed to so much filth they have extraordinary resistance).
  • Defensive Bonus: −4 AC vs. giants, ogres, trolls, and titans.
  • Class Restrictions: Gully dwarves can only be fighters or thieves, and their maximum level is typically limited.

Class Restrictions

Fighter (max 5th level), Thief (max 5th level). Generally used as NPCs.
system.requirements: Usually NPC only; DM discretion required for player characters
